description: Check a pending ujeebu_signup request. Works without a key. Poll about every 10 seconds (never faster than every 2 seconds). status values: pending_confirmation (the human has not clicked the link yet, keep polling), confirmed (the response contains api_key, shown ONCE: store it immediately, then reconnect to this MCP server with header Authorization: Bearer <key>), delivered (the key was already returned by an earlier poll and cannot be shown again), expired or declined (start over with ujeebu_signup if appropriate).

poll_token.description: poll_token returned by ujeebu_signup (starts with agp_). Secret: do not show it to anyone else.

request_id.description: request_id returned by ujeebu_signup (starts with ags_).

name: ujeebu_signup_status
